newsitem.title: RUSSIA: BASKETBALL-AVTODOR TAKE CSKA TO RUSSIAN DECIDER.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-AVTODOR TAKE CSKA TO RUSSIAN DECIDER.

text.p: Avtodor Saratov needed all their home advantage in the fourth game of the Russian play-off final on Friday to beat CSKA Moscow 95-93, levelling the series at 2-2 and setting up a decider on Sunday.

Avtodor, who overcame bitter CSKA objections to host play-off games at their tiny arena in Saratov, will again face the capital side in front of just a few hundred fans in the southern city in the final match.
The third-place play-off will also go to a fifth game decider on Sunday after Dynamo Moscow beat Samara 74-62.
